text: Let Z be a fair Rademacher sign, taking values +1 and -1 each with probability 1/2, and set X_t=Z*t for t in [0,1], equipped with Euclidean distance. For epsilon>0 let N(epsilon) be the minimum number of open Euclidean balls of radius epsilon, centered in [0,1], whose union covers [0,1]. Then E[sup_{t in [0,1]} X_t] <= 1 + 4*sqrt(2)*integral_{0}^{1/2} sqrt(log N(epsilon)) d epsilon. The integrand at epsilon=0 may be assigned any finite value without changing the integral.
scope: Concrete two-outcome linear process only; no claim for arbitrary sub-Gaussian processes, no all-radius integral or improved constants. Open balls are fixed explicitly; the separating bound N(1/2)<=3 works with either open or closed balls.
